verdict.rationale: The Agent Skills spec requires every SKILL.md to have YAML frontmatter, and agents load each skill's name and description at startup to decide when it is relevant, so the description doubles as the activation trigger. A hands-on probe confirmed that `skills add --list` shows every skill's name and full trigger description before anything is installed, which lets a developer predict behavior up front. missing for 10: evidence that the description field is mandatory and validated (the spec citations shown only cover optional fields), and the skills.sh website list not surfacing descriptions inline per community feedback.
